title: The canon format, read once for a skew check
objective: A skew check words its findings in the canon format that its caller read, so the realisation set and its wording cannot come from two reads.
body:
## Rows

Report F2's H3 (triage P23, its second half). P23's ruling stands: doctor reads the canon format from the disk.

## Deliverables

- `views::skew_against` takes the `CanonFormat` that its caller read, and does not call `intentfiles::reported_format` itself (`intentsvcs/src/views.rs:2818`).
- doctor passes the format that it read at `intentsvcs/src/doctor.rs:2203`. `views::skew` reads the reported format once and passes it on.
- The call in `intentsvcs/tests/view_skew_check.rs` passes a format.

## Approach

Add one parameter. The other route, a `Realised` that carries its format, changes a public type that more code reads.

## Dependencies

None.

## Risks

A caller passes a format other than the one it read `realised` in. doctor passes one variable to both calls.

## Verification

Before the bank, the builder runs clippy and critic-rust on its diff. No new test.

The batch decides this package: one `bin/devbin gate all` and one `bin/devbin test shell` at main's HEAD, after the last bank lands, booked by vc with the Desk. No gate and no suite runs for this bank alone.

## Seat and size

cc (intentsvcs). XS.
